description: This PHP source file defines a validation rule class 'LeaveTypeIdRule' within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. The class is used for validating leave type IDs by checking if the provided ID corresponds to an existing LeaveType entity, leveraging leave type services via traits.

classes.name: LeaveTypeIdRule
